basic_details.job_title: Dr. RML Hospital Junior Resident Recruitment 2026 – Apply Offline for 8 Posts
basic_details.short_information: Dr. Ram Manohar Lohia Hospital, Atal Bihari Vajpayee Institute of Medical Sciences (ABVIMS), New Delhi (Dr. RML Hospital) has invited applications for 8 posts of Junior Resident (Dental) under Advt No. HA-II-12021/1/2023-HA-II Section-Dr. RMLH. Applications are to be sent offline and must reach the organisation by 14 December 2026.

application_fee.sc_fee: Entitled for relaxation in submission of application fee
application_fee.details: Payment mode: NEFT and RTGS or online transfer to Medical Superintendent - Digital Payment Account, Bank of Baroda, Dr. RML Hospital, New Delhi; A/c No. 26020200000382; IFSC BARB0RAMDEL; MICR 110012061. Last date to pay the fee: 14 December 2026.

age_limit.age_details: Not exceeding 30 years for UR/EWS (as on last date of submission of application (14.12.2026))

qualification.education_qualification: BDS from a recognized University; Delhi Dental Council Registration Certificate/Acknowledgement; internship completed after 13.12.2024 and before the last date of submission of application.
qualification.details: Qualification: BDS from a recognized University; Delhi Dental Council Registration Certificate/Acknowledgement required for appearing in the examination; Permanent Registration Certificate of Delhi Dental Council mandatory for joining; Internship completed after 13.12.2024 and before the last date of submission of application Age limit: Not exceeding 30 years for UR/EWS (as on last date of submission of application (14.12.2026)) Age relaxation: OBC 3 years, SC 5 years, ST 5 years | Other conditions: | Indian Nationals only Permanent Registration Certificate of Delhi Dental Council mandatory for joining OBC certificate in Central Govt. proforma with Non Creamy Layer certificate issued on or after 01.04.2026 EWS Income & Asset Certificate issued on or after 01.04.2026 Hepatitis B vaccination status to be given as an undertaking at the time of joining

salary_details.pay_scale: Pay Level 10: Rs. 56100-1,77,500 plus applicable admissible allowances

exam_pattern.details: Written examination on 10.01.2027 (Sunday) Admit card with list of eligible candidates to be uploaded on hospital website

how_to_apply: Fill and sign the prescribed application form (Annexure-I) printed with the notice.
Pay Rs. 800/- (UR and OBC) by NEFT/RTGS or online transfer to Medical Superintendent - Digital Payment Account, Bank of Baroda, A/c 26020200000382.
Attach a latest passport size photograph, copy of fee receipt (UTR No.) and self-attested copies of all documents.
Send by post or by hand in the name of the Director, ABVIMS and Dr. RMLH.
Write 'Application for the Post of Junior Resident (Dental)' prominently on top of the envelope.
Application must reach the Central Diary & Dispatch Section, Near Gate No. 1, by 14.12.2026 till 03:00 PM.
important_instructions: All previous applications received in this hospital will be treated as cancelled Application without payment receipt will be summarily rejected No TA/DA will be paid No individual communication; all updates on www.rmlh.nic.in only Hospital not responsible for any postal delay Vacancies are provisional and may increase or decrease

content_sections.heading: Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Qualification: BDS from a recognized University; Delhi Dental Council Registration Certificate/Acknowledgement required for appearing in the examination; Permanent Registration Certificate of Delhi Dental Council mandatory for joining; Internship completed after 13.12.2024 and before the last date of submission of application Age limit: Not exceeding 30 years for UR/EWS (as on last date of submission of application (14.12.2026)) Age relaxation: OBC 3 years, SC 5 years, ST 5 years Other conditions: Indian Nationals only Permanent Registration Certificate of Delhi Dental Council mandatory for joining OBC certificate in Central Govt. proforma with Non Creamy Layer certificate issued on or after 01.04.2026 EWS Income & Asset Certificate issued on or after 01.04.2026 Hepatitis B vaccination status to be given as an undertaking at the time of joining

content_sections.text: 6 months initially, then extended to a period of one year on the recommendation of HOD

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for Dr. RML Hospital Recruitment 2026 Offline
content_sections.text: Fill and sign the prescribed application form (Annexure-I) printed with the notice. Pay Rs. 800/- (UR and OBC) by NEFT/RTGS or online transfer to Medical Superintendent - Digital Payment Account, Bank of Baroda, A/c 26020200000382. Attach a latest passport size photograph, copy of fee receipt (UTR No.) and self-attested copies of all documents. Send by post or by hand in the name of the Director, ABVIMS and Dr. RMLH. Write 'Application for the Post of Junior Resident (Dental)' prominently on top of the envelope. Application must reach the Central Diary & Dispatch Section, Near Gate No. 1, by 14.12.2026 till 03:00 PM.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for Dr. RML Hospital Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Applications must reach the organisation by 14 December 2026.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are there in Dr. RML Hospital Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are 8 vacancies for Junior Resident (Dental).

faq.question: Q3. How do I apply for Dr. RML Hospital Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Fill in the application form (Annexure-I (pages 4-5 of this notice)) and send it to Central Diary & Dispatch Section, Near Gate No. 1, ABVIMS & Dr. Ram Manohar Lohia Hospital, New Delhi-110001, by post or by hand, to reach by 14 December 2026.

faq.question: Q4. What is the application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: UR: Rs. 800. OBC: Rs. 800. EWS/SC/ST: Entitled for relaxation in submission of application fee.

faq.question: Q5. What is the age limit for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The age limit is not exceeding 30 years for UR/EWS (as on last date of submission of application (14.12.2026)). Relaxation: OBC 3 years, SC 5 years, ST 5 years.

faq.question: Q6. What is the salary for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Pay Level 10: Rs. 56100-1,77,500 plus applicable admissible allowances.

faq.question: Q7. What qualification is needed for this recruitment?
faq.answer: BDS from a recognized University; Delhi Dental Council Registration Certificate/Acknowledgement; internship completed after 13.12.2024 and before the last date of submission of application.

faq.question: Q8. Are there other conditions for this recruitment besides qualification and age?
faq.answer: Yes. Indian Nationals only. Permanent Registration Certificate of Delhi Dental Council mandatory for joining. OBC certificate in Central Govt. proforma with Non Creamy Layer certificate issued on or after 01.04.2026. EWS Income & Asset Certificate issued on or after 01.04.2026.

faq.question: Q9. Who cannot apply for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Candidates who have already done JR ship. Candidates whose internship was not completed after 13.12.2024 and before the last date of submission.

faq.question: Q10. How will candidates be selected for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Written MCQ test of one hour having 50 questions. Selection based on written examination. Marks declared on next working day of the written examination. Result within 4 working days from the date of declaration of marks.
